name: keeps the stages before delivery and only hints at adding the account
fullName: SellerEarningsCard — payout account keeps the stages before delivery and only hints at adding the account
description:
Payout account prompts on a seller's sale. Payouts are sent by Bling's finance
team by hand and are held until the seller has a bank account, so a delivered
sale without one must say so instead of showing the transfer stages.
